title: Associative monoidal descent along a compatible reflector
statement: Use [def-coef-complete-algebroid], [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category] and [lem-coef-presentable-infinity-adjoints], the generalized nonsymmetric operads and their algebra categories of [lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability], and the strongly saturated closure specified in [lem-coef-infinity-small-localization-saturation]. In the generalized-operad convention, the degree-zero fibre is a Kan space, inert edges are cocartesian over consecutive-subinterval maps, and the incidence-diagram axiom includes both vertex and edge projections. Let $\mathcal V$ be presentably monoidal, with no symmetry assumed, and $L:\mathcal V\rightleftarrows\mathcal U:i$ an accessible reflective localization. Suppose the class $W$ of arrows inverted by $L$ is stable under tensoring on either side by every object of $\mathcal V$. Then $\mathcal U$ has a presentably monoidal structure for which $L$ is strong monoidal, $i$ is lax monoidal, its unit is $L(\mathbf1)$, and $u\otimes_{\mathcal U}u'=L(iu\otimes_{\mathcal V}iu')$. For every monoidal infinity category $\mathcal E$, precomposition with $L$ identifies the infinity category of strong monoidal functors $\mathcal U\to\mathcal E$ with the full subcategory of strong monoidal functors $\mathcal V\to\mathcal E$ that invert $W$. For cocomplete $\mathcal E$, this equivalence restricts to the colimit-preserving functors. It includes monoidal natural transformations. If $W$ is generated as a strongly saturated class by a small set $S$, it suffices that tensoring every arrow of $S$ on either side by every object yields an arrow inverted by $L$. All comparisons are compatible with coherent diagrams of monoidal reflectors. Also, the full sub-operad of $\mathcal V^\otimes$ on lists of local objects is the operad associated with this lax monoidal inclusion; for every generalized nonsymmetric operad, its algebras form the full subcategory of $\mathcal V$-valued algebras whose colour values are local. For every small generalized nonsymmetric infinity operad $\mathcal O$, composition with these two monoidal functors gives a coherent adjunction $L_*:\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal V)\rightleftarrows\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal U):i_*$. Its unit and counit are induced by the relative monoidal adjunction, and the adjunction is natural under restriction along maps of operads.
